casos.entrada: I have expired milk at home. Can I drink it?

resposta.pergunta: I have expired milk at home. Can I drink it?

resposta.mensagem: Consuming expired milk is not recommended, as products past their expiration date may pose health risks and are considered unfit for consumption. If you have consumed it and have any health concerns or symptoms, please seek guidance from a qualified healthcare professional.
